# Synthetic assisted-review images

These images are original deterministic test fixtures generated by
`generate_fixtures.py`. The generator uses only Pillow drawing primitives,
fixed integer coordinates, fixed colors, PNG compression level 9, and no
metadata, timestamps, random values, external photographs, fonts, or network
resources.

The canonical fixture files are:

- `urban_minimal.png` (480 x 320)
- `facade_polygon.png` (480 x 360)

Identical byte copies are also generated under `../valid/images/`. Batch 2.1's
safe source-path contract forbids `..`, so annotations in `../valid/` reference
these confined copies as `images/<name>.png`. This duplication is intentional
and does not weaken the safe-path policy.
